On separate empty documents, walls from (0,0) to (1,0) and from (65536,0) to (65537,0) produce the same narrowed Cell(0,-1), North selector; this is source reasoning, not an executed edit.
An i32 minimum in the coordinate decremented by DrawWall reaches an unchecked subtract before i16 narrowing; whether such an input is supported is unresolved.
